title: Reconcile lake manifest paths and routing
requirement: Return one non-negative integer column named violation_count. A manifest declares the files expected for a delivery. az_expected_files defines file_id, exact path label, route and byte_count; az_files is the observed listing evidence with capture time and run_id. Paths are labels only: this app never reads local or cloud files from them. FULL JOIN by file_id; count missing/unexpected or wrong path/route/byte_count once per joined row plus duplicated file_id groups. Purpose: detect missing delivery, an extra file, repeated publication and wrong destination even when file counts match. RUN records the existing local evidence; it does not repair files or fetch a real Azure listing. This is per-file path/routing reconciliation, not the OneLake partition-level row-count exercise.
learning_objectives: Reconcile lake manifest paths and routing
Justify conclusions using independent keys, exact values and observable evidence.
